details.name: Wulfgard
details.quote: Catello Wulfgard Luppino, Endfield Crisis Team. I represent the Pack. Give me any merc job, and as long as our contract stands, I'll be your claws and fangs.
details.infection: Oripathy positive (infected), based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Combat Technique: Solo Wulfgard is always skilled at soloing and getting things done, and prefers bearing various responsibilities on his own.
details.exp2d: Infiltrator: Stealth Hiding one's trail is a skill paramount for surviving the wildlands. Wulfgard happens to be quite gifted in this.
details.hb1d: Nature: Wilderness Scout The wildlands is his hunting grounds. A qualified hunter is more than happy to be attuned to changes in the environment, be it ambient humidity, shifts in the wind, or the cascading sounds of the flowing creek...
details.hb2d: Creative: Weapon Modding Modifying etched ammo might be a boring job, but he enjoys finding people to test them on.
